status: Integrated and exported in Prototype 38 / 0.38.0; packaged regression checks passed; visual review pending
requirement: When the existing Flushfiend-clear condition unlocks a progress barrier, animate the door sliding vertically down into the floor instead of disappearing instantly.

animation.motion: Slide downward from current closed position until completely below floor; clip at floor so no door is visible beneath ground.
animation.state: closed -> opening -> open, once per gate; pause freezes animation.
animation.collision: Keep physical collision consistent with visible remaining door; never allow shots through still-visible solid sections or leave an invisible wall after fully open.
animation.persistence: Retain opened gates on checkpoint respawn under existing progression rules; full restart restores closed state.

art: Reuse existing service-shutter-v1.png if suitable; ask Bestiary / Art before creating additional artwork.
verification: Clear requirement triggers opening once, not instantaneous disappearance.
Intermediate position visible; monotonic downward movement reaches fully open.
Player and projectile collision consistent throughout.
Pause/resume, checkpoint respawn, and full restart maintain correct gate state.
Door audio triggers once, aligns with motion/end, pauses/resumes cleanly and does not replay on restored open gates.
delivery_owner: Engineering owns runtime/build/roadmap/storybook updates; no game foreground without permission.

audio.status: Integrated in Prototype 42 / 0.42.0; packaged transitions, pause, restore and cleanup checks pass; listening pending
audio.requirement: Mechanical door-opening sound synchronized with first-level progress door sliding down into floor.
audio.direction: Brief latch release, motor/metal movement during slide, and restrained end-stop clunk.
audio.timing: Follow actual opening duration, currently0.9s; trigger once on closed-to-opening transition, end-stop on fully open.
audio.lifecycle: Pause with door, resume without restarting cue; stop on level exit/restart. No replay for already-open doors or checkpoint restoration.
audio.mix: Audible over level music without drowning out combat; route through game SFX settings.
audio.provenance: Audio supplies versioned source/runtime cue and manifest with provenance; Engineering integrates after delivery.
